title: Slide Array Spotting Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.15.0 or later), P300 Multi‑Channel Pipette (GEN2), Axygen 4‑channel reservoir (73 mL), Abgene 96‑well plate (200 µL), and any needed tips, reagents, or pipettes.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the desired protocol parameters in the OT‑2 Run App interface before proceeding.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file (.py) from the provided source and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required .json labware files.

substeps.instruction: Go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT‑2 App, upload the downloaded .py protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, perform calibration of the tip rack, pipette, and all labware; consult support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT‑2 App to start the slide‑array spotting protocol.
